import "regexp"
from(bucket: "inverter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "battery_chain1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic =~ /voltage_cell[1-4]_bms1/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: regexp.replaceAllString(r: /.*sensor\/(voltage_cell[0-9]_bms[0-9])\/state/, v: r.topic, t: "$1")}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
